title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7

blocks.source_text: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 is here with a brand new music disc and a flurry of new blocks! These are the final gameplay features for the upcoming game drop, so grab your tools, turn up the music, and let's get to mining and crafting!
blocks.translated_text: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 已经上线，带来了全新的音乐光盘和许多新的方块！这些是即将推出的游戏更新中的最终游戏功能，所以准备好你的工具，打开音乐，让我们开始采矿和制作吧！

blocks.source_text: Happy building!
blocks.translated_text: 建筑愉快！

blocks.source_text: New Features
blocks.translated_text: 新增功能

blocks.source_text: Added Calcite Blockset
blocks.translated_text: 新增了方解石方块集

blocks.source_text: Added a new Music Disc with the track "Flurry" by Hyper Potions
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一张音乐光盘，其中收录了 Hyper Potions 演唱的曲目“Flurry”

blocks.source_text: Added a new decorative block to the game... somewhere
blocks.translated_text: 游戏中新增了一种装饰性方块……不过具体位置暂时未知

blocks.source_text: Calcite
blocks.translated_text: 方解石

blocks.source_text: Added the Calcite Block Set
blocks.translated_text: 新增了方解石方块集

blocks.source_text: Calcite now has a Pillar, Slab, Stair, and Wall variant
blocks.translated_text: 方解石现在有了柱子、板块、楼梯和墙壁三种形态

blocks.source_text: Calcite Pillars, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls can also be crafted using a Stonecutter
blocks.translated_text: 方解石柱子、板块、楼梯和墙壁也可以使用切石机来制作

blocks.source_text: Added the Polished Calcite Block Set
blocks.translated_text: 添加了抛光方解石块集

blocks.source_text: Polished Calcite can be crafted from 2x2 Calcite Blocks
blocks.translated_text: 抛光方解石可以从2x2的方解石块制作而成

blocks.source_text: Polished Calcite, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls can also be crafted using a Stonecutter
blocks.translated_text: 抛光方解石、石板、楼梯和墙壁也可以使用切石机制作

blocks.source_text: Added the Polished Calcite Bricks Block set
blocks.translated_text: 添加了抛光方解石砖块集

blocks.source_text: Polished Calcite Bricks can be crafted from 2x2 Polished Calcite Blocks
blocks.translated_text: 抛光方解石砖可以从2x2的抛光方解石块制作而成

blocks.source_text: Polished Calcite Brick Slabs, Stairs, and Walls can also be crafted using a Stonecutter
blocks.translated_text: 抛光方解石砖石板、楼梯和墙壁也可以使用切石机制作

blocks.source_text: Calcite, Polished Calcite, and Polished Calcite Bricks belong to the Slow Bouncy Sulfur Cube archetype
blocks.translated_text: 方解石、抛光方解石和抛光方解石砖都属于“缓慢跳跃的硫方怪”原型

blocks.source_text: Music and Sound
blocks.translated_text: 音乐与音效

blocks.source_text: Added a new music disc
blocks.translated_text: 添加了一张新的音乐磁盘

blocks.source_text: "Flurry" by Hyper Potions
blocks.translated_text: 歌曲 "Flurry" 由 Hyper Potions 创作

blocks.source_text: Has a chance of being found in Igloo basement Chests
blocks.translated_text: 有几率在冰屋地下的箱子里找到

blocks.source_text: Has a comparator output of 7 when played in a Jukebox
blocks.translated_text: 在唱片机中使用时会输出比较器的结果 7

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 发生了变化

blocks.source_text: Updated the Main Menu background panorama
blocks.translated_text: 更新了主菜单的背景画面

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体进行了小幅调整

blocks.source_text: Being on fire now counters the Freezing Effect similar to wearing leather armor
blocks.translated_text: 现在着火可以抵消冷冻效果，类似于穿着皮革盔甲

blocks.source_text: Wearing any piece of leather armor will prevent Zombies and Skeletons from converting into Frostbites or Strays
blocks.translated_text: 穿着任何一件皮革盔甲都可以防止僵尸和骷髅变成霜冻状态或游荡状态

blocks.source_text: Strays now spawn in the following biomes:
blocks.translated_text: 游荡状态的角色现在会在以下生物群系中生成：

blocks.source_text: Deep Frozen Ocean
blocks.translated_text: 极寒冰洋

blocks.source_text: Frozen Ocean
blocks.translated_text: 冰冻海洋

blocks.source_text: Frozen Peaks
blocks.translated_text: 冰冻山峰

blocks.source_text: Frozen River
blocks.translated_text: 冰冻河流

blocks.source_text: Jagged Peaks
blocks.translated_text: 崎岖的山峰

blocks.source_text: Snowy Slopes
blocks.translated_text: 积雪的斜坡

blocks.source_text: "Graphics API" Video Setting
"Default" will now randomly pick either OpenGL or Vulkan on each startup

**Developer's Note**: *As we've been defaulting to Vulkan for this snapshot series, we have had little testing on the OpenGL backend. After some recent big changes to our rendering code, we want to temporarily test both backends. This will be reverted in a future snapshot.*
Realms
The "Play" buttons in the Realms menus are now purple
UI
Hovering entries in lists, such as friends or worlds, now outlines the entry in gray
blocks.translated_text: 在列表中悬停时（例如好友或世界），对应的条目会以灰色轮廓显示

blocks.source_text: Navigating to edit boxes now differs between keyboard and arrow key navigation
blocks.translated_text: 使用键盘和箭头键导航时，进入编辑框的方式有所不同

blocks.source_text: When using the Tab key, the edit box will be focused and editable
blocks.translated_text: 使用 Tab 键时，编辑框会变为可编辑状态

blocks.source_text: When using arrow keys, the edit box will be highlighted but not editable, similar to slider buttons
blocks.translated_text: 使用箭头键时，编辑框会被高亮显示但无法编辑，与滑块按钮类似

blocks.source_text: Pressing Enter or Space will make the box editable
blocks.translated_text: 按下 Enter 或空格键后，编辑框将变为可编辑状态

blocks.source_text: The mouse cursor is now hidden while navigating the UI with the keyboard, and reappears when the mouse is moved
blocks.translated_text: 使用键盘导航 UI 时，鼠标光标会隐藏；当移动鼠标时，光标会重新出现

blocks.source_text: Added a tooltip to the recipe book button
blocks.translated_text: 为配方书按钮添加了工具提示

blocks.source_text: Accessibility
blocks.translated_text: 辅助功能（可访问性优化）

blocks.source_text: Gameplay screens, such as the Crafting Table, now support keyboard navigation and narration
blocks.translated_text: 游戏玩法界面（如制图台）现在支持键盘导航和语音播报

blocks.source_text: **Developer's Note**: *This is the first step towards making gameplay screens more accessible. As always, we'd love to hear your feedback, so please head on over to [the feedback site](https://aka.ms/MCKeyboardNavigationNarrationGameplayScreensJava).*
blocks.translated_text: **开发者备注**：*这是让游戏画面更易使用的第一步。一如既往，我们很乐意听取您的反馈，请访问[反馈网站](https://aka.ms/MCKeyboardNavigationNarrationGameplayScreensJava)。

blocks.source_text: Gameplay Screen Keyboard Navigation
blocks.translated_text: 游戏画面的键盘导航

blocks.source_text: Gameplay screens can now be focused and used with the keyboard
blocks.translated_text: 现在可以使用键盘聚焦和操作游戏画面

blocks.source_text: Tab moves between groups of slots, and the arrow keys move between slots within a group
blocks.translated_text: Tab 键在不同的物品槽组之间切换，箭头键在同一个槽组内的物品之间切换

blocks.source_text: The Stonecutter recipes, Loom patterns, Enchanting Table options, and Villager and Wandering Trader trades are also navigated as a group
blocks.translated_text: 切石机配方、织布机图案、附魔台选项以及村民和流浪商人的交易也属于同一组可导航的选项

blocks.source_text: The following interactions can be used on slots:
blocks.translated_text: 可以在这些物品槽上执行以下操作：

blocks.source_text: Enter/Space behaves as a left-click
blocks.translated_text: 按 Enter/Space 键相当于左键点击

blocks.source_text: Holding Control while pressing Enter/Space behaves like a right-click
blocks.translated_text: 按住 Control 键再按 Enter/Space 键相当于右键点击

blocks.source_text: Holding Shift while pressing Enter/Space behaves like Shift-clicking
blocks.translated_text: 按住 Shift 键的同时按 Enter/Space 键的行为类似于使用 Shift 键点击

blocks.source_text: Double-pressing Enter/Space collects matching items, like double-clicking
blocks.translated_text: 双击 Enter/Space 键可以收集相同类型的物品，类似于双击操作

blocks.source_text: Moving with the arrow keys while holding Enter/Space spreads the carried stack across slots, like holding left-click and dragging with the mouse
blocks.translated_text: 按住 Enter/Space 键的同时使用箭头键移动，会将携带的物品堆分配到其他槽位中，类似于按住鼠标左键并拖动

blocks.source_text: The hotbar keys and the Drop item key act on the focused slot
blocks.translated_text: 热键和物品掉落键作用于当前聚焦的槽位

blocks.source_text: The Creative Inventory and the Recipe Book are not yet supported
blocks.translated_text: 创意背包和食谱书目前还不支持

blocks.source_text: Gameplay Screen Narration
blocks.translated_text: 游戏玩法画面的文字说明

blocks.source_text: The narrator now reads out slots in gameplay screens
blocks.translated_text: 现在画面上会有文字提示用户的操作结果，例如告诉玩家选择的是哪个槽位

blocks.source_text: Slots are narrated with their contents, item tooltip, and name for special slots such as armor, fuel, and potion slots
blocks.translated_text: 对于特殊槽位（如护甲、燃料和药水槽位），系统会同时说明槽位的名称、内含物品以及物品的提示信息

blocks.source_text: The slot's position is narrated (e.g. "3 out of 9") in a group or as a column and row in a grid
blocks.translated_text: 槽位的位置会通过文字提示出来（例如：‘第3个槽位（共9个）’），无论是作为一组显示还是作为网格中的行列显示

blocks.source_text: Stonecutter recipes and Loom patterns are narrated with their column and row, and trades and Enchanting Table options with their position in the list
blocks.translated_text: 切石机的制作配方和织布机的图案会以行列形式展示；交易和附魔台的相关选项则根据其在列表中的位置进行说明。

blocks.source_text: When a group is focused, the narrator mentions which arrow keys move within it
blocks.translated_text: 当选中的群体被高亮显示时，旁白会说明哪些箭头键可用于在该群体内移动。

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术性变更。

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 126.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本现已更新为126.0。

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 102.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本现已更新为102.0。

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 126.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本：126.0

blocks.source_text: Commands
blocks.translated_text: 命令功能。

blocks.source_text: The effect command now accepts mob effect tags
blocks.translated_text: 现在，“effect”命令可以接受怪物效果标签作为参数。

blocks.source_text: Time arguments now fail if the provided value in ticks is greater than 2147483647
blocks.translated_text: 如果提供的时间值（以游戏刻为单位）超过2147483647，命令将无法正常执行。

blocks.source_text: Debug Worlds
blocks.translated_text: 调试世界功能。

blocks.source_text: Can now be modified as normal with block placement, breaking, and commands
blocks.translated_text: 现在可以通过放置方块、破坏方块和使用命令来正常修改它们

blocks.source_text: The blocks will no longer update automatically, you must create a new debug world to see new blocks
blocks.translated_text: 这些方块将不再自动更新，你需要创建一个新的调试世界才能看到新的方块

blocks.source_text: Now include one of each entity type
blocks.translated_text: 现在每种实体类型都会包含一个实例

blocks.source_text: Entity types that can be babies will have a baby version included above the adult version
blocks.translated_text: 能够产下幼年的实体类型，在成年版本的上方会显示幼年版本

blocks.source_text: Will now be tick-frozen on load
blocks.translated_text: 加载游戏时这些实体将被设置为“冻结”状态

blocks.source_text: Will now be created in "Normal" difficulty
blocks.translated_text: 这些实体现在将在“普通”难度模式下生成

blocks.source_text: Will now have the following game rules set to false :
blocks.translated_text: 现在以下游戏规则将被设置为“关闭”状态：

blocks.source_text: advance_time
blocks.translated_text: advance_time

blocks.source_text: advance_weather (this was already the case, listing here for completeness)
blocks.translated_text: advance_weather（这个功能本来就已经存在了，这里只是为了完整性而列出）

blocks.source_text: Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 7
blocks.translated_text: 修复了26.4快照7中的漏洞

blocks.source_text: [MC-80859](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-80859) - Starting to drag item stacks over other compatible stacks makes the latter invisible until their stack size increases
blocks.translated_text: [MC-80859](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-80859) - 将物品堆拖动到其他兼容的物品堆上时，后者会暂时变得不可见，直到它们的堆大小增加

blocks.source_text: [MC-148140](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-148140) - The scroll bar in the stonecutter UI appears 2 pixels too low when at the bottom of its rail
blocks.translated_text: [MC-148140](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-148140) - 在切石机界面中，当滚动条位于轨道底部时，显示位置低了2像素

blocks.source_text: [MC-165610](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-165610) - The scroll bar in the trading UI reaches the bottom too early
blocks.translated_text: [MC-165610](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-165610) - 交易界面的滚动条会过早到达底部

blocks.source_text: [MC-185630](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-185630) - The bounding boxes of options in the enchanting table UI for clicking and hovering are inaccurate
blocks.translated_text: [MC-185630](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-185630) - 在附魔台界面上，用于点击和悬停的选项边界框不精确

blocks.source_text: [MC-235363](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-235363) - Stonecutter recipe hitboxes are misaligned in height
blocks.translated_text: [MC-235363] - 切石机的制作配方显示区域在高度上存在对齐问题

blocks.source_text: [MC-264554](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-264554) - The button highlights of focused trades in the trading UI move to other trades when scrolling
blocks.translated_text: [MC-264554] - 在交易界面中，高亮显示的道具在被滚动时，会转移到其他道具上

blocks.source_text: [MC-270272](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-270272) - Any mouse button can be used to select options in the enchanting table UI
blocks.translated_text: [MC-270272] - 在附魔台界面中，可以使用任意鼠标按钮来选择选项

blocks.source_text: [MC-270555](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-270555) - The outline of certain slots is obscured before the item is placed within the slot
blocks.translated_text: [MC-270555] - 在物品放入插槽之前，某些插槽的边框会暂时被遮盖

blocks.source_text: [MC-280006](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-280006) - Experience orbs floating around a player no longer fall to the ground when that player leaves the server
blocks.translated_text: [MC-280006] - 当玩家离开服务器时，漂浮在玩家周围的经验球不再掉落到地面

blocks.source_text: [MC-297502](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-297502) - Any mouse button can be used to select options in the enchanting table, loom and stonecutter UIs
blocks.translated_text: [MC-297502] - 在附魔台、织布机和切石机界面中，可以使用任意鼠标按钮来选择选项

blocks.source_text: [MC-297624](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-297624) - The stonecutter UI buttons are not keyboard-navigable, preventing the player from refilling the input by pressing Space
blocks.translated_text: [MC-297624] - 切石机的用户界面按钮无法通过键盘导航，玩家无法通过按空格键来重新输入内容

blocks.source_text: [MC-298546](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-298546) - The loom UI buttons are not keyboard-navigable, preventing the player from refilling the inputs by pressing Space
blocks.translated_text: [MC-298546] - 织布机的用户界面按钮无法通过键盘导航，玩家无法通过按空格键来重新输入内容

blocks.source_text: [MC-298547](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-298547) - The enchanting table UI buttons are not keyboard-navigable
blocks.translated_text: [MC-298547] - 附魔台的用户界面按钮无法通过键盘导航

blocks.source_text: [MC-302022](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-302022) - Experience orbs desync after bouncing on lava
blocks.translated_text: [MC-302022] - 经验值球在碰到熔岩后会失去同步

blocks.source_text: [MC-306817](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-306817) - The scroll position in the trading UI is not synced to the visual scroll bar when there's a large amount of trades
blocks.translated_text: [MC-306817] - 当交易数量较多时，交易界面的滚动位置与可视滚动条不同步

blocks.source_text: [MC-306853](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-306853) - /time does not throw errors when the values are too high
blocks.translated_text: [MC-306853](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-306853) - 当数值过高时，/time 不会抛出错误

blocks.source_text: [MC-307422](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-307422) - Changing the window size causes warnings in the game log
blocks.translated_text: [MC-307422](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-307422) - 改变窗口大小会导致游戏日志中出现警告

blocks.source_text: [MC-307991](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-307991) - The game prefers to use the software GPU (llvmpipe) with the Vulkan rendering backend rather than the actual GPU with the OpenGL one when the GPU in use does not support Vulkan
blocks.translated_text: [MC-307991] - 当使用的 GPU 不支持 Vulkan 时，游戏更倾向于使用软件 GPU（llvmpipe）和 Vulkan 渲染后端，而不是实际的 OpenGL GPU

blocks.source_text: [MC-309586](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309586) - The scroll position in the stonecutter UI resets when taking an item out of the result slot
blocks.translated_text: [MC-309586] - 从结果格中取出物品时，切石机界面的滚动位置会重置

blocks.source_text: [MC-311029](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311029) - The equipment entity predicate doesn't support the saddle slot
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311029] - 设备实体谓词不支持马鞍槽

blocks.source_text: [MC-311520](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311520) - writeToTexture and copyBufferToTexture never check for GL errors, unlike the neighboring methods

content:
Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 is here with a brand new music disc and a flurry of new blocks! These are the final gameplay features for the upcoming game drop, so grab your tools, turn up the music, and let's get to mining and crafting!

Happy building!

New Features

Added Calcite Blockset

Added a new Music Disc with the track "Flurry" by Hyper Potions

Added a new decorative block to the game... somewhere

Calcite

Added the Calcite Block Set

Calcite now has a Pillar, Slab, Stair, and Wall variant

Calcite Pillars, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls can also be crafted using a Stonecutter

Added the Polished Calcite Block Set

Polished Calcite can be crafted from 2x2 Calcite Blocks

Polished Calcite, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls can also be crafted using a Stonecutter

Added the Polished Calcite Bricks Block set

Polished Calcite Bricks can be crafted from 2x2 Polished Calcite Blocks

Polished Calcite Brick Slabs, Stairs, and Walls can also be crafted using a Stonecutter

Calcite, Polished Calcite, and Polished Calcite Bricks belong to the Slow Bouncy Sulfur Cube archetype

Music and Sound

Added a new music disc

"Flurry" by Hyper Potions

Has a chance of being found in Igloo basement Chests

Has a comparator output of 7 when played in a Jukebox

Changes

Updated the Main Menu background panorama

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Being on fire now counters the Freezing Effect similar to wearing leather armor

Wearing any piece of leather armor will prevent Zombies and Skeletons from converting into Frostbites or Strays

Strays now spawn in the following biomes:

Deep Frozen Ocean

Frozen Ocean

Frozen Peaks

Frozen River

Jagged Peaks

Snowy Slopes

"Graphics API" Video Setting

"Default" will now randomly pick either OpenGL or Vulkan on each startup

**Developer's Note**: *As we've been defaulting to Vulkan for this snapshot series, we have had little testing on the OpenGL backend. After some recent big changes to our rendering code, we want to temporarily test both backends. This will be reverted in a future snapshot.*

Realms

The "Play" buttons in the Realms menus are now purple

UI

Hovering entries in lists, such as friends or worlds, now outlines the entry in gray

Navigating to edit boxes now differs between keyboard and arrow key navigation

When using the Tab key, the edit box will be focused and editable

When using arrow keys, the edit box will be highlighted but not editable, similar to slider buttons

Pressing Enter or Space will make the box editable

The mouse cursor is now hidden while navigating the UI with the keyboard, and reappears when the mouse is moved

Added a tooltip to the recipe book button

Accessibility

Gameplay screens, such as the Crafting Table, now support keyboard navigation and narration

**Developer's Note**: *This is the first step towards making gameplay screens more accessible. As always, we'd love to hear your feedback, so please head on over to [the feedback site](https://aka.ms/MCKeyboardNavigationNarrationGameplayScreensJava).*

Gameplay Screen Keyboard Navigation

Gameplay screens can now be focused and used with the keyboard

Tab moves between groups of slots, and the arrow keys move between slots within a group

The Stonecutter recipes, Loom patterns, Enchanting Table options, and Villager and Wandering Trader trades are also navigated as a group

The following interactions can be used on slots:

Enter/Space behaves as a left-click

Holding Control while pressing Enter/Space behaves like a right-click

Holding Shift while pressing Enter/Space behaves like Shift-clicking

Double-pressing Enter/Space collects matching items, like double-clicking

Moving with the arrow keys while holding Enter/Space spreads the carried stack across slots, like holding left-click and dragging with the mouse

The hotbar keys and the Drop item key act on the focused slot

The Creative Inventory and the Recipe Book are not yet supported

Gameplay Screen Narration

The narrator now reads out slots in gameplay screens

Slots are narrated with their contents, item tooltip, and name for special slots such as armor, fuel, and potion slots

The slot's position is narrated (e.g. "3 out of 9") in a group or as a column and row in a grid

Stonecutter recipes and Loom patterns are narrated with their column and row, and trades and Enchanting Table options with their position in the list

When a group is focused, the narrator mentions which arrow keys move within it

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 126.0

The Resource Pack version is now 102.0

Data Pack Version 126.0

Commands

The effect command now accepts mob effect tags

Time arguments now fail if the provided value in ticks is greater than 2147483647

Debug Worlds

Can now be modified as normal with block placement, breaking, and commands

The blocks will no longer update automatically, you must create a new debug world to see new blocks

Now include one of each entity type

Entity types that can be babies will have a baby version included above the adult version

Will now be tick-frozen on load

Will now be created in "Normal" difficulty

Will now have the following game rules set to false :

advance_time

advance_weather (this was already the case, listing here for completeness)

spawn_wandering_traders

tnt_explodes

Tags

Removed unused #swimming and #flying Entity Type Tags

Block Sound Sets

Removed unused minecraft:twisting_vines block sound set

Resource Pack Version 102.0

Block Sprites

Renamed Block Textures:

Renamed block/icicle_down_base.png to block/icicle_base.png

Renamed block/icicle_down_frustum.png to block/icicle_frustum.png

Renamed block/icicle_down_middle.png to block/icicle_middle.png

Renamed block/icicle_down_tip.png to block/icicle_tip.png

Renamed block/icicle_down_tip_merge.png to block/icicle_tip_merge.png

Added new Block textures:

block/calcite_pillar_side.png

block/calcite_pillar_top.png

block/polished_calcite.png

block/polished_calcite_bricks.png

block/polished_calcite_slab_side.png

Item Sprites

Added new Item texture:

item/music_disc_flurry.png

Sounds

Added new sound event:

entity.parrot.imitate.frostbite

translated_content:
Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 7 已经上线，带来了全新的音乐光盘和许多新的方块！这些是即将推出的游戏更新中的最终游戏功能，所以准备好你的工具，打开音乐，让我们开始采矿和制作吧！

建筑愉快！

新增功能

新增了方解石方块集

新增了一张音乐光盘，其中收录了 Hyper Potions 演唱的曲目“Flurry”

游戏中新增了一种装饰性方块……不过具体位置暂时未知

方解石

新增了方解石方块集

方解石现在有了柱子、板块、楼梯和墙壁三种形态

方解石柱子、板块、楼梯和墙壁也可以使用切石机来制作

添加了抛光方解石块集

抛光方解石可以从2x2的方解石块制作而成

抛光方解石、石板、楼梯和墙壁也可以使用切石机制作

添加了抛光方解石砖块集

抛光方解石砖可以从2x2的抛光方解石块制作而成

抛光方解石砖石板、楼梯和墙壁也可以使用切石机制作

方解石、抛光方解石和抛光方解石砖都属于“缓慢跳跃的硫方怪”原型

音乐与音效

添加了一张新的音乐磁盘

歌曲 "Flurry" 由 Hyper Potions 创作

有几率在冰屋地下的箱子里找到

在唱片机中使用时会输出比较器的结果 7

发生了变化

更新了主菜单的背景画面

对方块、物品和实体进行了小幅调整

现在着火可以抵消冷冻效果，类似于穿着皮革盔甲

穿着任何一件皮革盔甲都可以防止僵尸和骷髅变成霜冻状态或游荡状态

游荡状态的角色现在会在以下生物群系中生成：

极寒冰洋

冰冻海洋

冰冻山峰

冰冻河流

崎岖的山峰

积雪的斜坡

\\

在列表中悬停时（例如好友或世界），对应的条目会以灰色轮廓显示

使用键盘和箭头键导航时，进入编辑框的方式有所不同

使用 Tab 键时，编辑框会变为可编辑状态

使用箭头键时，编辑框会被高亮显示但无法编辑，与滑块按钮类似

按下 Enter 或空格键后，编辑框将变为可编辑状态

使用键盘导航 UI 时，鼠标光标会隐藏；当移动鼠标时，光标会重新出现

为配方书按钮添加了工具提示

辅助功能（可访问性优化）

游戏玩法界面（如制图台）现在支持键盘导航和语音播报

**开发者备注**：*这是让游戏画面更易使用的第一步。一如既往，我们很乐意听取您的反馈，请访问[反馈网站](https://aka.ms/MCKeyboardNavigationNarrationGameplayScreensJava)。

游戏画面的键盘导航

现在可以使用键盘聚焦和操作游戏画面

Tab 键在不同的物品槽组之间切换，箭头键在同一个槽组内的物品之间切换

切石机配方、织布机图案、附魔台选项以及村民和流浪商人的交易也属于同一组可导航的选项

可以在这些物品槽上执行以下操作：

按 Enter/Space 键相当于左键点击

按住 Control 键再按 Enter/Space 键相当于右键点击

按住 Shift 键的同时按 Enter/Space 键的行为类似于使用 Shift 键点击

双击 Enter/Space 键可以收集相同类型的物品，类似于双击操作

按住 Enter/Space 键的同时使用箭头键移动，会将携带的物品堆分配到其他槽位中，类似于按住鼠标左键并拖动

热键和物品掉落键作用于当前聚焦的槽位

创意背包和食谱书目前还不支持

游戏玩法画面的文字说明

现在画面上会有文字提示用户的操作结果，例如告诉玩家选择的是哪个槽位

对于特殊槽位（如护甲、燃料和药水槽位），系统会同时说明槽位的名称、内含物品以及物品的提示信息

槽位的位置会通过文字提示出来（例如：‘第3个槽位（共9个）’），无论是作为一组显示还是作为网格中的行列显示

切石机的制作配方和织布机的图案会以行列形式展示；交易和附魔台的相关选项则根据其在列表中的位置进行说明。

当选中的群体被高亮显示时，旁白会说明哪些箭头键可用于在该群体内移动。

技术性变更。

数据包的版本现已更新为126.0。

资源包的版本现已更新为102.0。

数据包版本：126.0

命令功能。

现在，“effect”命令可以接受怪物效果标签作为参数。

如果提供的时间值（以游戏刻为单位）超过2147483647，命令将无法正常执行。

调试世界功能。

现在可以通过放置方块、破坏方块和使用命令来正常修改它们

这些方块将不再自动更新，你需要创建一个新的调试世界才能看到新的方块

现在每种实体类型都会包含一个实例

能够产下幼年的实体类型，在成年版本的上方会显示幼年版本

加载游戏时这些实体将被设置为“冻结”状态

这些实体现在将在“普通”难度模式下生成

现在以下游戏规则将被设置为“关闭”状态：

advance_time

advance_weather（这个功能本来就已经存在了，这里只是为了完整性而列出）

spawn_wandering_traders

tnt_explodes

标签

移除了未使用的 #swimming 和 #flying 实体类型标签

区块音效集

移除了未使用的 minecraft:twisting_vines 匹配音效集

资源包版本 102.0

区块精灵

更改了区块纹理的命名

将 block/icicle_down_base.png 重命名为 block/icicle_base.png

将 block/icicle_down_frustum.png 重命名为 block/icicle_frustum.png

将 block/icicle_down_middle.png 重命名为 block/icicle_middle.png

将 block/icicle_down_tip.png 重命名为 block/icicle_tip.png

将 block/icicle_down_tip_merge.png 重命名为 block/icicle_tip_merge.png

添加了新的方块纹理

block/calcite_pillar_side.png

block/calcite_pillar_top.png

block/polished_calcite.png

block/polished_calcite_bricks.png

block/polished_calcite_slab_side.png

物品精灵（Item Sprites）

添加了新的物品纹理：</text

item/music_disc_flurry.png

音效

添加了新的音效事件：</text

entity.parrot.imitate.frostbite

修复了26.4快照7中的漏洞

[MC-148140](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-148140) - 在切石机界面中，当滚动条位于轨道底部时，显示位置低了2像素
